classification: Post-event retrospective training and separately registered prospective contract-transfer test
hypothesis: Origin-available other-provider price-change context lowers seven-day quantile pinball relative to an otherwise matched price-history model

data.target_definition: Daily median of recorded positive quality-ok source/provider/GPU/instrument/tier/SKU/region/node groups. This is not an official target, persistent listing, or verified executed transaction. Null metadata stays null; ambiguous same-timestamp groups excluded before performance.
data.selection: Round-robin sorted provider/family/source groups with at least 20 past observations and three observed providers in their source/GPU/instrument/tier market. Metadata/data availability only; never model loss.

features.primary_group: source-specific other-provider within-group return context and observed collector composition
features.shared: Origin-safe own-price summaries in both arms
features.price_comparison_gate: Recorded nonmissing region and node agreement; unmatched dollar prices never pooled
features.return_context: Each return uses the same source-defined group at both dates before aggregation once per other provider. Cross-contract dollar levels are not compared.

training.selection: Lowest development seven-day pinball; checkpoint zero eligible; earliest update exact tie
training.learning_rate_selection: Fixed at v18 development-selected 0.0001, no new sweep

evaluation.historical_label: Retrospective, reused and dependent origins; no independent accuracy claim
evaluation.frozen_v18_control: No exact target match: new provider-group medians differ from v18 collector medians; do not reuse v18 scores as a matched control
